title: Ground state density computation
action: Solve the coupled time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii equations for a two-component 2D BEC with Rashba SOC (λ_R=0.2, λ_D=0) using imaginary-time propagation on a sufficiently large uniform 2D grid. Run for interaction strengths g=3, 10, 15 with N=150 atoms. Obtain stationary wavefunctions ψ1, ψ2 and total density ρ.
description: Required intermediate that computes the ground state wavefunction and density, consumed by the downstream Bogoliubov step.

title: Bogoliubov excitation dispersion
action: For each g, construct the 4×4 Bogoliubov matrix from the ground state solution and diagonalize it for q_x ranging from 0 to 6 (step ≤0.05, q_y=0). Extract the lowest positive excitation eigenvalue.
description: Raw excitation energies for the lowest Bogoliubov branch. Must contain at least 100 q points per g for the roton-minima detection and integrity cross-check.
output_schema: Columns: g (int), q_x (float), q_y (float, all 0.0), omega_lowest (float, dimensionless units).

title: Roton minima identification
action: Analyze the dispersion data in step_03_dispersion.csv. For each g, detect local minima in omega_lowest as a function of q_x (ignore the endpoint q_x=0). Count the number of minima.
description: The final scored artifact: the number of roton minima per interaction strength, verifying the transition from phonon-only (0 minima) to single roton to double roton as interaction increases.
output_schema: Columns: g (int), num_minima (int). Three rows: g=3, 10, 15.
